title: Specimen (Simplified Input)
description: A user-friendly form to describe a physical specimen: its name, mass, material identity, and optional physical source. This input is automatically converted to a standardised RDF representation following the PMDCo duality-object-material pattern and PROV-O provenance pattern.

specimen_name.title: Specimen Name
specimen_name.description: A human-readable name or identifier for the specimen. Example: '316L Tensile Bar #1', 'AlSi10Mg disc A3'.

mass_value.title: Mass Value
mass_value.description: Optional. Mass of the specimen as a positive number. If provided, mass_unit must also be given.

mass_unit.title: Mass Unit
mass_unit.description: Unit for the mass value. Required when mass_value is provided. Choose one of: 'g' (gram), 'kg' (kilogram), 'mg' (milligram).

material.title: Material
material.description: Abstract alloy or substance identity of this specimen (PMDCo duality pattern). Select an existing material record from the knowledge graph. Can be auto-populated from source when source is set.

source.title: Source
source.description: The specific semi-finished product (e.g. metal sheet) this specimen was cut or prepared from. Select an existing semi-finished-product record from the knowledge graph.
